info.title: Wetland Multi-Station Acoustic Observation Service
info.description: Groups records of the same sound heard at several wetland stations into one event, using per-boot clock calibration, a coarse-to-fine grid search over the configured observation area, and an exclusive set-packing solver. On top of the event stream it serves comparability reports: activity rates of two regions restricted to their comparable sample, with coverage facts, incomparable strata and versioned knowledge cutoffs — never a population estimate. Results are exploratory field-survey output, not an alerting service.

post.summary: Record an investigator exclusion for one event
post.description:
Record an investigator's explicit exclusion of a station for one event.

The exclusion is stored with its reason and station, and the event's
finalization block is updated *only if* that station was the reason the
event was still provisional.  A judgement about one station never silently
finalises an event that has other unsettled stations.

get.summary: Diff two report versions and explain what changed
get.description:
Version difference between two cutoffs.

Late shutdown or calibration information produces a new report at a new
cutoff; this endpoint shows, stratum by stratum, which coverage facts and
rates changed, and lists the evidence that arrived between the two
cutoffs.  The baseline report itself stays reproducible.

post.summary: Re-derive the report at its original cutoff and compare hashes
post.description:
Re-derivation check: an old report must be exactly reproducible.

The computation only reads evidence received at or before the report's
cutoff, so late shutdown or calibration information cannot change what the
old report said — it can only produce a *new* report at a new cutoff.

post.summary: Issue the same report at a new cutoff (late evidence creates a new version)
